mapper.select:
SELECT code AS "code", name AS "name", spec AS "spec",
(SELECT c.name FROM clients c WHERE c.client_code = products.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", COALESCE(stock_qty, 0) AS "stockQty" FROM products WHERE COALESCE(discontinued, 0) = 0
AND name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%'
AND (SELECT c.name FROM clients c WHERE c.client_code = products.client_code LIMIT 1) ILIKE '%' || #{clientName} || '%'
ORDER BY name DESC ORDER BY name ASC

SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = production_schedule.product_code) AS "productName", order_qty AS "orderQty" FROM production_schedule WHERE actual_qty IS NULL

SELECT code AS "code", name AS "name", spec AS "spec", (SELECT c.name FROM clients c WHERE c.client_code = products.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", COALESCE(stock_qty, 0) AS "stockQty" FROM products
WHERE (SELECT c.name FROM clients c WHERE c.client_code = products.client_code LIMIT 1) ILIKE '%' || #{clientName} || '%'
ORDER BY name
SELECT product_code AS "productCode", material_cost AS "materialCost" FROM pricing
SELECT product_code AS "productCode", COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS "qty" FROM product_stock_movement WHERE moved_on > #{date} GROUP BY product_code
